description: This is a React-like front-end component source file (using LightningJS framework) defining the 'Home' page of a travel explorer application. It imports components, themes, data functions, and renders a structured UI template with dynamic data loading.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home page with header, navigation, hero section, and destination list that loads data asynchronously.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: An asynchronous hook that initializes the destinations data by fetching real data, falling back to stub data if fetch fails, and updates the component state accordingly.
